newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Sibneft in talks on $400 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Sibneft in talks on $400 mln credit.

text.p: Russian oil company NK Sibneft is in talks with foreign banks about a $400 million credit, a company official said on Monday.

Sibneft, one of a dozen vertically integrated Russian oil groups created over the last few years, whose main operating unit is Noyabrskneftegaz NYGS.RTS, is in talks with Credit Lyonnais, Salomon Brothers and Raiffeisen Zentral-Bank Oesterreich about several credits worth $400 million total on different terms, the official told Reuters.

"The board of directors will soon single out the bank, which is ready to grant the credit at the most profitable terms," he said. "We have suggested backing the credit from Credit Lyonnais and Raiffeisen Zentral-Bank with deliveries of three million tonnes of crude oil in the framework of Sibneft's contract with a firm from Gibraltar."
He said Sibneft was to deliver 250,000 tonnes of oil from April 1997 to March 1998 to the company.
